title: Foundry evaluator
description: An evaluator that scores agent responses along a quality dimension. Items in an evaluators array may be inline or a $ref to an external file. Builtin evaluators (e.g., builtin.task_adherence) can be referenced by name without a local_uri; custom evaluators require a local_uri pointing to the evaluator definition file.

name.description: Evaluator name. Builtin evaluators use a 'builtin.' prefix (e.g., 'builtin.task_adherence', 'builtin.response_completeness'). Custom evaluators use a project-scoped name.

version.description: Version of the evaluator. When omitted, the latest version is used. For builtin evaluators, pins to a specific version. For custom evaluators, identifies the uploaded version.

local_uri.description: Relative path to the local evaluator definition file. Required for custom evaluators. The extension uploads this file to the Foundry project on deploy.
